definitions.explanation: An actor whose work is in films rather than on stage or television. Used of both men and women, though {女優|じょゆう} is the usual word when the gender is being specified.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}だった。
examples.english: My father was a movie actor.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れていた→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: I had looked up to movie actors since childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んだ→積む：02294_tsumu⟧あと、{三十歳|さんじゅっさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After gaining experience on the stage, he made his name as a film actor at thirty.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a film actor
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}: a popular film actor
- {映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim to be a film actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: actor — the general term, covering stage, film, and television
- ⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧: actress — used far more often than {映画俳優|えいがはいゆう} for women
- ⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧: actor — traditional and slightly old-fashioned, with a stage flavor
- ⟦スター→スター：00393_sutaa⟧: star — fame rather than profession
